rationale: No dedicated pitfalls section. The 'Non-Negotiable Rules' section contains 4 anti-patterns (don't modify source, don't fabricate, don't mark style as P0/P1, write to disk immediately) but these are framed as rules rather than pitfalls with explanations. No explicit '常见坑' or '反模式' section exists.

evidence_refs.quote: - 审查阶段不修改源文件
- 不捏造问题 — 每个发现必须有精确代码证据
- 纯风格问题不得标记为 P0/P1
- 所有产物立即写入磁盘，不保留内存状态
